patches.purpose: Name the Windows executable micro3D, show µ3D in the window title and About dialog, and use the project icon while keeping Blender version and API identifiers.
Store configuration and cache data in micro3D directories on Windows, Linux and macOS so an existing Blender profile is left untouched.
Enable the viewport, object manager, attributes and timeline, with labeled tools and a switchable navigation preset.
Provide a default-off build option so the USD importer can compile on Windows hosts that cannot create its precompiled header.
